mark_affecting.quote: Dramatic Irony. Audience knows more than characters. We know Dunsey is dead, but villagers do not.

flagged.title: Eppie's Childhood & Godfrey's Secret
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly states that Eppie actually falls into the stone-pit where Dunsey drowned, which is a major plot error that would penalise a GCSE English Literature student.

mark_affecting.quote: When Eppie toddles away and actually falls into the stone pit — yes, the exact same pit where Dunsey drowned — Silas absolutely panics.
